comments.author: dzole0311
comments.body:
These raw keys should probably live in a separate `RawMMGISProjectionConfig` type, with the adapter receiving a normalized version. 

(ie. the comment `//all other keys from MMGIS config.json file` is describing something that belongs in a different type)
